# Support

## Bug reports and feature requests

Use GitHub Issues. Search existing issues first to avoid duplicates.

## Questions, design discussion, and ideas

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/avalon-initiative/discussions)
for open-ended questions, design sanity checks, and early ideas. Issues are
fine too when the question is tied to specific work.

Both are durable and searchable, so anything you'd want to find again later
belongs in one of them.

## Chat

The [Avalon Discord](https://discord.gg/FFDsFw9F4g) is for drop-in chat and
quick questions. It is not a durable record: conversations there aren't
indexed or preserved the way Issues and Discussions are, and nothing decided
in chat counts as decided until it is written up in an issue or a
Discussion.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contributor workflow, and
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) if you're reporting a vulnerability rather than
a bug.
